people.name: Betty Zentall
people.notes: Born 1915. Maiden name Aigner, married name Zweigenthal (1939), changed to Zentall after immigrating to USA in 1942. Moved from Hungary to Paris in 1929.

people.name: Robert Zentall
people.notes: Born 1908. Original surname Zweigenthal, changed to Zentall after immigrating to USA in 1942. Army photographer in Czech division of French army. Stationed in Agde, France.

people.name: Edmund Zachar
people.notes: Original surname Zweigenthal, changed to Zachar after immigrating to USA

people.name: Thomas Zentall
people.notes: Born 1940, conceived while Robert was stationed in Agde, France

people.name: Sarah Roosevelt
people.notes: Helped Robert and Betty immigrate to the US in October 1942

timeline.1929: Betty moved from Hungary to Paris

key_facts: Robert and Betty were Jewish living in Europe during WWII
They fled Europe to escape Nazi persecution
Robert was a photographer for the Czech division of the French army
Robert fought against Axis forces, including his home country Germany
Betty was pregnant during much of the correspondence
The family was separated during the war while Robert was deployed
They eventually immigrated to the United States

notes: Reference data for OCR correction of WWII-era letters between Robert and Betty Zentall (originally Zweigenthal). These are primarily wartime correspondence written in French and German between 1939-1942. The letters document their courtship, marriage, Robert's military service, Betty's pregnancy, and their eventual escape from Nazi-occupied Europe to the United States.
